_excludeReason: src/attestation/** used to be excluded wholesale, so nothing in it was typechecked - an undefined import in AttestationDebugPanel.tsx passed a green build. What remains out is the part this app does not run: server/** is a Node service needing express, pg, redis, google-auth-library and @simplewebauthn/server, none of which belong in a mobile dependency tree; hooks/** and the executeAttested chain need expo-device, jail-monkey and json-canonicalize and are unreachable from the app, which imports only client/deviceAssessment. Everything else - classification, shared, native, and the rest of client - is now checked. The jest suites are excluded separately and for an unrelated reason: they are run by jest, which supplies describe/it/expect, and tsc has no types for those globals.
